stances.summary: Cyclosporiasis outbreak reveals gaps in U.S. public health capacity
stances.quote: Dean @meganranney.bsky.social joined CNN yesterday to discuss the current cyclosporiasis outbreak and what it can tell us about the current capacity of our nation's public health system.

stances.summary: Virus from outbreak appears unchanged from 2018
stances.quote: Also: so far, the sequencing of the virus from this outbreak suggests that it is unchanged from the 2018 outbreak (written with humility: I am not a virologist)

stances.summary: Skeptical attribution of health outcome to specific virus
stances.quote: Oh for sure. But unlikely to be because of this specific virus.

stances.summary: Promotes expert credibility and competent public health communication
stances.quote:
To watch an interview with actual experts—2 of the best respected & most trusted experts in virology, @angierasmussen.bsky.social, & public health, @meganranney.bsky.social—watch this CNN interview: observe their competence, expertise, experience, & strong messaging
